title: Declare an empty list
description:
Declare an empty list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as empty_list(), returning an empty list.
hints: A list literal is written with square brackets containing comma-separated values.
An empty list needs no values between the brackets at all.
Return [] - two square brackets with nothing between them.
explanation: [] is the literal for an empty list - no elements means nothing needs to go between the brackets.
